concerns.text: The plan implements salience computation with OpenCV’s spectral‑residual algorithm (see “CPU‑only generation of pixel‑wise salience maps using OpenCV’s spectral‑residual algorithm…”) while the specification (FR‑001) requires the DeepGaze II model. Spectral‑residual salience captures only low‑level contrast cues and does not align with the intended construct of *computational visual salience* as defined by DeepGaze II, which incorporates higher‑order features. This mismatch threatens construct validity: the predictor may not measure the theoretical construct, jeopardizing the ability to answer the primary research question about visual salience’s influence on attention.
